FaultKind.description: The kind of deterministic fault a Provider applies (SE-3).

Ident.description:
A name inside one document, matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`.

Names are compared as bytes; there is no case folding and no Unicode
normalisation, so the canonical form of OV-15 stays byte-comparable.

Rule: SB-1.

at_ns.description: Nanoseconds after T0, in the inclusive range `0..=2^62` (SE-3).

target.description: The Run fragment that owns the fault (SE-3).
